answer_1.quote: We propose FLAN-FinXC, a generative framework, consisting of a suite of instruction-tuned FLAN-T5 models, varying in model sizes and training strategies, to tackle the XFNL task, which is a practically important problem in the finance domain.

answer_2.quote: To ensure a comprehensive evaluation of all models, we employ the following metrics: 1) Macro-Precision, 2) Macro-Recall, 3) Macro-F1
